VghLantern__CreationWizard__Config.VghLantern__CreationWizard__Config__Desc: System configuration overlay for the Lantern Creation Wizard. Merged over VghLantern__AppConfig__Main__.json by AppCore ConfigLoader and read back through ConfigLoader.GetSection('CreationWizard'). The wizard collects only the decisions that shape a new lantern; every other value stays on the schema and seed defaults. To add a future step: add an entry to the Steps array here, then register its field binding in VghLantern__CreationWizard__Steps__.js STEP_BINDINGS. Steps write to existing project-file fields only, so the wizard never touches the JSON schema.

VghLantern__CreationWizard__Config__Beha.BehaviourNote: Enabled false restores the old silent default-lantern creation on every path. RunForFirstLantern false limits the wizard to the editor's + Add Lantern button. SectionTransitionMs drives the overlay entrance and the section expand/collapse; AutoFocusDelayMs holds the caret back until the section is mostly open so the focus scroll never fights the animation.
